text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 08 · 临海长桌与凉廊.
Environment:  An empty intimate Mediterranean dining pergola above the sea, cream stone columns and light oak slat canopy with translucent ivory fabric diffusing the light. A long warm-brown table offset left, modest ceramic dishes, folded linen napkins and a glass water carafe, mismatched woven chairs. Pale gravel garden and olive tree to right; wide gap at center gives view to the sea and low coastal hills. Soft bright summer light, shallow low-contrast stripes only, tactile everyday luxury, no elaborate banquet excess.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 08 · 临海长桌与凉廊. Create ONE clear TRUE FLAT 2D floor plan or outdoor site plan reconstructing this exact reference scene, for staging and spatial understanding. Show only this location and immediate footprint, not a whole unrelated complex. Preserve distinctive architecture, openings, landmarks and furniture positions. Infer unseen bounds conservatively, mark inferred extension dashed. Black technical lines on white, pale zone fills, wall thickness, door arcs, windows, furniture horizontal footprint symbols, outdoor paths/water/terrain where relevant. North arrow is conceptual sheet orientation. No perspective, no raised walls, no fake dimension/scale numbers, no people or animals. Small English zone labels, title CONCEPT PLAN, large uncluttered plan. Good proportions and connected walkable passages. Landscape format.
